rows.text: I wish to learn how to make biangbiang noodles with a Xi'an family.
I wish to cycle the Xi'an City Wall just before sunset.
I wish to spend an unhurried afternoon in a neighborhood teahouse in Chengdu.
I wish to taste a traditional Beijing breakfast in a quiet hutong.
I wish to hear how the Terracotta Warriors are restored and protected.
I wish to learn a friendly game of mahjong from Chengdu locals.
I wish to try Chinese paper-cutting in a small family workshop.
I wish to walk through a Xi'an morning market and try the local breakfast.
I wish to see how a Peking Opera performer prepares their makeup.
I wish to fold dumplings and exchange family recipes around the table.
I wish to join a Tai Chi practice in a local park at sunrise.
I wish to learn the brush strokes used to write my name in Chinese.
I wish to shop at a Chengdu market before cooking a Sichuan meal.
I wish to meet a Beijing kite maker and build one of my own.
I wish to pick tea leaves and learn how Longjing tea is roasted.
I wish to meet a Xi'an shadow-puppet artist and try moving the figures.
I wish to learn the first steps of bamboo weaving from a Chengdu artisan.
I wish to share a home-cooked dinner in a traditional courtyard.
I wish to take a slow train and spend a day in a small Chinese town.
I wish to photograph an old street as the neighborhood wakes up.
